regime_context: The detector shows Banks as the single dominant eligible narrative (trend-tagged, durable, crowded, one-narrative structure) but the market's own history says the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown here (gate_helps=false), so trend discipline is experimental/display on China A-shares. emerging_watch: Watch Coal (515220.SS): the only theme above 0.5 besides Banks with a rising relative score versus a crowded leader. If Coal fails to clear either threshold within 30 days, the watch retires.
